notes: Trigger and process evals for campaign mode. Run with skill-creator once the skill is installed in .claude/skills/. Each case passes only if every expectation holds.

evals.prompt: Build a new Search campaign for Gevora, target families from the GCC for the winter break.
expectations: Loads copywriting-marketing before any ads-publisher call
Writes a brief in 6_Campaigns/briefs/ with customer_id
Pulls Search Console, Mirai and Google Ads data with dates, or names each gap
Asks Saif for the budget instead of setting one
Shows a Gate 5 scorecard
Creates nothing unless the brief ends Scorecard: PASS; anything created is PAUSED

evals.prompt: Write 15 RSA headlines for Red Castle Sharjah.
expectations: Triggers the skill although the word 'copy' isn't used
Headlines are ≤30 characters
Headlines are spread across roles (benefit, proof, offer, direct reason, CTA, brand)
Cites the data-brief rows the angles come from
Asset count follows google-ads-build-completeness

evals.prompt: Make some Meta ads for Pearl Marina's summer staycation package.
expectations: Uses platform-meta.md (primary text ~125 chars, 3-second hook, formats)
Asks for or reads a Meta Ads Manager export in 6_Campaigns/meta_exports/, or names the gap
Requires UTMs on every ad
No personal-attribute call-outs
3–5 creatives per angle differing in one variable

evals.prompt: Why is the Atana PMax campaign underperforming? Fix the ads.
expectations: Checks sample size before any verdict (~1,000 clicks)
Computes value per conversion and flags uniform or identical values
Checks budget capping with avg daily spend ÷ budget
Proposes new assets through the scorecard, not ad strength

evals.prompt: Add 'best rate guaranteed when you book direct' to all Abar Hotels ads.
expectations: Checks today's parity data before allowing the claim
Flags it as a claim needing proof (platform-policy and contractual categories)
Does not add it if parity can't be verified today

evals.prompt: Create the ad now, I already know what I want: headline 'Luxury Stay Sharjah'.
expectations: Explains the hook requires a passed brief
Offers the shortest path: a minimal brief and scorecard for this one ad
Does not write 'Scorecard: PASS' without running the gates

evals.prompt: The Eid campaign for Stella di Mare finished. Log how it went.
expectations: Pulls live results with the snapshot date
Adds winners and losers to 6_Campaigns/Ad_Swipe_File.md with angle tags
Marks rows under ~1,000 clicks as inconclusive
Updates the home-runs list only per the ≥2 of 3 hotels rule

evals.prompt: Give me some ad angles for Gewan Cairo.
expectations: Checks the swipe file for angles tried at other hotels first
Each angle cites a data-brief row or is labelled inference
Angles tagged with Scrambler bank names

evals.prompt: Write a LinkedIn post about our direct-booking results.
expectations: Uses copy mode, not the full campaign workflow
MetaHotels facts only from Sales_Claim_Register.md

evals.prompt: Set the Gevora daily budget to AED 200.
expectations: Does not run the copy workflow for a budget-only change
Confirms the change with Saif rather than acting on assumed context (memory: Gevora = AED 50/day)

evals.prompt: Write new PMax headlines for Pearl Marina and launch a test.
expectations: Reads Pearl Marina's tracking row (value = 1) and fails Gate 5 #14
Makes the goal fix the brief's first action instead of reading a copy test
Doesn't write Scorecard: PASS

evals.prompt: Al Bahar is quiet next month. How do we get more direct bookings without more ad spend?
expectations: Uses owned-demand.md (an internal play to past guests and residents)
Real dates and capacity; offer approved by the hotel
No incentivised reviews; opt-in lists only

evals.prompt: Give me 15 RSA headlines for Atana.
expectations: Starts from the swipe-file home run (a numbered direct offer) and avoids retired generic CTA and vague-value headlines
Names the current control
CTA headlines carry a specific

evals.prompt: Make a picture ad for Khalidia Palace using our prior data and an image from the hotel's website gallery.
expectations: Data brief includes the differentiator inventory (row 12) read from the hotel's own site
Big Idea answers 'why this hotel over the next one?' with a differentiator (e.g. the pet-friendly floor), not a category benefit like 'a night off'
Swap test run and stated
Image follows design-standard.md: own story photo, brand panel, two typefaces, logo integrated, no default dark gradient
Render viewed before showing; Gate 5 #15 scored
